title: Gasoline crack z>1 shorts JETS/SPY ratio
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Gasoline crack spread 20d z-score > 1 weighs on the airline basket relative to the market rather than single names; trade short JETS/SPY ratio 3d at 1d lag [finance.spread.gasoline_crack -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0073)
message: Null: gasoline crack z>1 does not weigh on JETS/SPY (r=0.04, perm p=0.02 but wrong sign; short rule hit 50%, avg -0.20%, OOS -0.11%, actionability 0.5)

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.spread.gasoline_crack rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short ratio:jets_spy next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Gasoline crack spread 20d z-score > 1 fails to short JETS/SPY (hit 50%, avg -0.2%); test the reversal: crack z>1 marks exhaustion and the airline basket rebounds vs market (+); trade long JETS/SPY ratio 5d at 2d lag [finance.spread.gasoline_crack -> finance.ratio.jets_spy] (parent: R2-0173)
